Name: Ginger Island Extra Locations
Author: mistyspring
Description:
Ginger Island feels awfully small for how big it seems in the map- so i'm here to fix that.
This mod adds a 9 locations- some of them are: SouthWest beach, a deeper zone of the East forest, an abandoned cave in SouthEast, and a few others.
There's an end-game mining zone, and a legend that hints how to unlock it.

If you want a spoiler:
Light spoiler:
[spoiler]
You may see changes as you play more in Ginger Island.
[/spoiler]

Medium spoiler:
[spoiler]
By the time you get to Qi, some statues will be activated.
[/spoiler]

Big spoiler:
[spoiler]
You need to unlock all four zones of the island. Since the east is visitable right away, it counts Parrot Express as "East" requirement.
[/spoiler]

In the future, i may expand the mod further!
